properties.name: Un Mural Amarillo
properties.description:
A Yellow Mural is a large-scale collaborative mural created by four artists in Cali, Colombia. Spanning approximately 60 m² (15 m wide × 4 m high), the piece explores themes of unconditional love, care, and solidarity, inspired by the relationship between people experiencing homelessness and their animal companions.

This mural is the result of a collaborative artistic process supported by decentralized cultural communities, and it stands as a public artwork focused on social impact and collective values.

Davin Oyesigye is a community leader and builder from Uganda. He proposed an ambitious plan: fund the construction of four brand-new classroom blocks, a new Administration block, Kitchen and Dinning Hall for Ndurumo Primary School, giving hundreds of kids a safe and inspiring place to learn the Uganda Primary Curriculum Courtesy of the Universal Primary Education program by the government of Uganda.

Until the concluded nouns feurbishment project, many of these students were studying in overcrowded, crumbling spaces:
